images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A road-trip management game screen with vintage circus lithograph styling: background of faded red-and-cream tent stripes. Top-left a crimson marquee sign ringed with glowing light bulbs reading '마지막 순회 서커스', beside cream stat pills '12일째', '남은 도시 4 곳', and a red 'D−19' countdown. Left: a hand-drawn parchment road map with ink mountains, a river, forests and a sea corner, towns labeled '소금항', '검은재 탄광마을', '안개내 온천', '은행나무골', '붉은등 항구' each with small audience-taste tags; a convoy of four tiny red trailers kicks up dust along a solid red road toward the highlighted mining town, dotted routes beyond. Right: a dark wooden program board '오늘 밤 프로그램' with five cream act cards (clown, fire-eating siblings, unicycle tower, the old ringmistress on the high wire) and one dashed empty slot '코끼리 보름의 자리' asking what replaces the retired elephant, plus replacement options and a seat forecast bar. Bottom: six troupe portrait cards with morale, injury and age bars and tags like '고령', '화상'. Warm crimson, cream, gold leaf, soft grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The final performance inside a big-top circus tent, cinematic and bittersweet: crimson and cream canvas stripes radiating from the apex, swags of warm bulb string lights, two wooden center poles and a high wire. Spotlight cones converge on an elderly ringmistress balancing on the wire with a red parasol, a halo of light behind her. Below, a sawdust ring with a red-and-gold rim where six troupe members in colorful costumes bow in a line and three small dogs sit, lit by a warm spotlight pool. Dark silhouettes of a packed audience in tiered rows fill the foreground, many with raised arms, rim-lit in amber; confetti falls everywhere. Top center serif headline '서른한 해의 막이 내린다' with small caption '마지막 공연 · 은행나무골'. Top-left dark panel '박수 소리 98' with a gauge. Top-right a tilted cream ticket stub '마지막 프로그램' with checked acts. Bottom center quote and two buttons '인사하기' and '막 내리기'. Deep reds, gold, warm haze, film grain. Correction: the elderly ringmistress appears exactly once, on the high wire; the six members bowing in the ring are the other troupe members (a clown, two fire-eating sisters, a unicycle performer, a young stagehand, one more acrobat) — no elderly woman or red-coat ringmistress in the bowing line.
